description: This file defines the DefaultTimeoutConfig class which implements the TimeoutConfig interface. It manages configuration related to timeout durations, specifically minimum and maximum timeout values, and provides methods to instantiate the configuration based on external config data.

classes.name: DefaultTimeoutConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing TimeoutConfig interface, encapsulating minimum and maximum timeout durations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultTimeoutConfig using a Config object to load timeout settings.

methods.name: getMinTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured minimum timeout duration.

methods.name: getMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured maximum timeout duration.
